Alejandra: Need a micro-unfreeze for APAC slice to push v3.4.3-quickfix (checkpointing bug). Window 03:10-03:25 UTC. Scoped to serve-models group only. @Ben can you confirm SRE?
Ben: On it. Quick prechecks: autoscaler OK, az distribution healthy, disk IO normal. Will verify GPU mem headroom.
SRE-bot: GPU memory headroom: 20% across eu/apac pools. No pending maintenance.
Alejandra: QA smoke required on canary before ramp. QA-bot, can you stand by?
QA-bot: Ready. Will run smoke once canary is up. Abort thresholds: errors > 1% OR p95 > 450ms.
deploy-bot: Unfreeze request accepted. Starting canary: v3.4.3-quickfix -> apac-canary-01 (4%).
deploy-bot: Canary health checks passing. Warming caches.
Ben: Running smoke against canary now:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://apac-api.redwood.dev/generate -d '{"prompt":"healthcheck","max_tokens":5}'
```
QA-bot: Smoke OK: HTTP 200, p95 110ms, sample outputs valid.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @4m: errors 0.08%, p95 116ms 5; marking healthy.
Alejandra: Proceed to 30% then 100 if stable. Rollback plan: pin to v3.4.2 and `deploy-bot rollback --slice apac --to v3.4.2`. Whoever triggers rollback, notify #incidents and ops channel.
deploy-bot: Ramp to 30% complete.
QA-bot: Post-30% smoke green. One minor latency blip noticed but within threshold.
Alejandra: Lift freeze for serve-models subgroup only. Final ramp in 2m.
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% complete. v3.4.3-quickfix is live in apac.
Ben: Monitoring for 30m. If anything, page SRE oncall.
Alejandra: I'll update the release notes and mark the freeze-lift. Thanks team :tada:
